answer: The bound executable check is the recorded outcome. A unanimous wrong panel is classified as panel_error, not a minority view. A crashed check records NOT-CHECKED and never copies the vote. When the check agrees with the panel, the reason is still executable_check, not the tally.

evidence.claim: Unanimous-but-wrong panel versus a passing executable probe: 5/5 seats voted 000000000000…; the check asserted 74ffaac34761…; recorded outcome is the check, dissent_kind=panel_error (not minority_view).
Probe-failure honesty: when the bound check exits 2 with no JSON, outcome is NOT-CHECKED and is not the unanimous vote 000000000000….
evidence.probe_output: TST-0274 planted probe crash: no asserted fact

evidence.claim: Both-states: when the probe agrees with the panel, reason is executable_check, not unanimous_tally. The disagreeing case on the same proposition still records the check, so agreement is not a hidden tally.

negative_controls.description: broken_vote_fallback_on_error copies the unanimous vote into outcome when the check ERRORS. Production settle_dispute must stay NOT-CHECKED. The mutant proves the probe can see the forbidden state.
